description: Weekly, grouped dependency updates, as in jespersen, kuleshov and kempelen.

kuleshov and kempelen (git dependencies pinned by `rev` in Cargo.toml) are bumped by hand: a new commit can change the output, so each bump runs the parity test first (docs/parity.md), and the parity references belong to their pinned FFmpeg build and Kokoro files.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: The owner's libraries: bumped by hand, with the parity test.
